site.title: RuangImprove — A Space for You to Level Up

hero.title: A Space for You to Level Up.
hero.lede: From being confused about which student org to join, to being nervous about the job market after graduation, you don't have to walk alone here. There are circles, mentors, and collaborative projects.

about.title: From "Empty Space" to a "Growth Space"
about.p1: It all started from a late-night street food chat at 11 PM, filled with the same worries: "Can we actually upgrade together, instead of doing it alone?"
about.p2: At first it was just a small WhatsApp group of us who were tired of seeing timelines full of other people's achievements while feeling stuck ourselves. No mentors, no direction, just guts.
about.p3: RuangImprove was created to change that. We build learning spaces filled with peers on the same journey, mentors willing to lend a hand, and real projects so your CV isn't empty anymore by your final semester.

programs.title: Level Up, Together
programs.subtitle: You don't need to be perfect. Just start, the rest comes with the circle.
programs.card1Desc: 8 weeks with practitioner mentors + 5-6 fellow fighters. Clear targets, not just aimless chatting.
programs.card2Desc: Chat with seniors who've made it through internships, jobs, or postgraduate studies — no sugarcoating, real stories of ups and downs.
programs.card3Desc: Build real projects with cross-campus teams. The results can go straight into your portfolio and CV.

cta.title: Tired of Walking Alone?
cta.subtitle: Your circle is waiting at RuangImprove. You don't need skills first, just guts and willingness to start.

quiz.introTitle: What Type of Founder Are You?
quiz.introSub: Answer 7 quick questions and find out if you're a Hacker, Hipster, or Hustler.
quiz.shareText: I'm a {title}! What type of founder are you?

hacker.title: Hacker
hacker.desc: The Hacker develops the new technology for the business, builds new product prototypes, and works on product development.

hipster.title: Hipster
hipster.desc: The Hipster shapes how the product looks and feels — obsessed with design, user experience, and the story the brand tells.

hustler.title: Hustler
hustler.desc: The Hustler drives the business forward — sales, deals, partnerships, and making sure the product actually reaches people.
